item.tib: mdo brag lhun grub stag rtse'i bsang mchod 'dod 'byung gter 'phring
item.coloph: de ltar gnas bdag mdo brag lhun grub stag rtsa'i bsang mchod 'dod 'byung gter 'phreng (phreng) zhes bya ba/ shel zhig gdung 'dzin rnam rgyal ming gis bka' yi (yis) bskul ngor/ bdag 'dra sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can gyis mthong snang byung ba'i ngog nas shar bzhin bris pa/ gnas skabs kun tu bkra shis bde legs kyi khyab par gyur cig/
